verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing is explicitly API-first, with API endpoints for cards, cardholders, spending controls, disputes, real-time authorization, testing, and even a dedicated agent-oriented card issuance flow (docs-1 through docs-23), plus an official MCP server for AI agent interaction (docs-16, probe-4). However, community evidence notes the Dashboard offers richer UX for controls/budget management than the API alone provides (stripe-issuing-comm-1), and some workflows (physical card design/appearance, digital wallet provisioning flows) are documented primarily as dashboard/guided flows rather than confirmed full API parity. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that every dashboard action (e.g., card design customization, dispute guided flow, funding setup) has a fully equivalent API call with no dashboard-only steps.
